Thawed; wrap using native long-name variant
That was quite a battle! Thank you!
That was easy! See my strength?
I just got stopped... Why now?
It's so fun, that I can't get enough!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}É tão divertido que
não consigo parar!

entries.concept: If I battle this much, I'm bound to lose...
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}De tanto batalhar,
uma hora eu perco...

entries.concept: I didn't have to be so serious, did I?
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Nem precisava levar
tão a sério, né?

entries.concept: I did my best. I have no regrets!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Dei o meu melhor.
Não me arrependo!

entries.concept: I still have a long way to go!
Arrrrr! I want to be stronger!
This is how a Pokémon veteran fights!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}É assim que se batalha
com experiência!

entries.concept: I have to start all over again!
I guess there's always someone stronger...
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Acho que sempre há
alguém mais forte...

entries.concept: Yes! I won! On to the next battle!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Isso! Eu venci!
Vamos à próxima batalha!

entries.concept: Battles are easy once you're used to them!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Com a prática, as
batalhas ficam fáceis!

entries.concept: There are things I still don't know?
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Ainda há coisas
que eu não sei?

entries.concept: Yeah! I moved a step forward!
I'll never give up! I will win next time!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Nunca vou desistir!
Na próxima, eu venço!

entries.concept: Pokémon battles are so much fun!
Battles aren't so easy for a beginner...
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Para iniciantes,
batalhar não é tão fácil...

entries.concept: I've entered a new world of friendship!
No one has more friends than me!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Ninguém tem mais
amigos do que eu!

entries.concept: Make lots of friends by battling a bunch!
I'm not sad! I just made a new friend.
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Não estou triste!
Fiz uma nova amizade.

entries.concept: Yeah! We're friends from now on!
You're my rival, not my friend!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Você é meu rival,
não meu amigo!

entries.concept: Did you see that? The power of love!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Viu só?
É o poder do amor!

entries.concept: Even though I lost, I still love them!
It's a storm of wins wherever I go!
I don't want to hear a storm of boos!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}Não quero ouvir uma
tempestade de vaias!

entries.concept: What? That's it? That's all you got?
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}O quê? Só isso?
É só isso que você tem?

entries.concept: The rain was a blessing for me!
entries.target:
{F006}{F101}A chuva foi uma
bênção para mim!

entries.concept: It's pouring rain inside my heart...
